# Settings

## Server

`cowbird-server` reads these from the environment or from `.env` in the
working directory. Names are not case-sensitive.

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `API_KEYS` | unset | Comma-separated API keys. Every route except `/health` requires one in `x-api-key`. |
| `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | unset | Comma-separated origins allowed by CORS. Empty allows none. |
| `RATE_LIMIT` | `"30/minute"` | Per-key rate limit, in `slowapi` syntax. |
| `WAIT_MAX` | `25` | Longest a `/wait` request is held, in seconds, whatever `timeout` the client asks for. |
| `WAIT_DEFAULT` | `25` | How long `/wait` holds when the client sends no `timeout`. |
| `WEBHOOK_MAX` | `600` | Longest a webhook waits for mail, in seconds. Pending webhooks live in process memory. |
| `DATABASE_URL` | unset | Postgres URL. Set, issued addresses and quarantines are shared between instances. Unset, they live in process memory. |
| `INSTANCE_ID` | `<hostname>-<pid>` | This instance's key for its own health rows. Must be stable across restarts and unique per process. |
| `HEALTH_FLUSH_SECONDS` | `10` | How often health is written to and read from Postgres. |
| `WEBHOOK_SECRET` | unset | Set, each webhook delivery carries `x-cowbird-signature: sha256=<hmac>` of the body. |
| `WEBHOOK_ALLOW_PRIVATE` | off | Allow webhook URLs on private, loopback and link-local addresses. Leave off outside a test stack. |

## Library and CLI

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `COWBIRD_SOLVER_URL` | unset | URL of a running cloudflare-solver. Unset, providers that need it are skipped. See [the solver guide](../guides/cloudflare-solver.md). |
| `COWBIRD_HEALTH_PATH` | `~/.cowbird/health.json` | Where the CLI keeps provider health between runs. |
